title: Pearl Harbor: The Morning That Changed the World

identity.paletteIntent: Naval midnight #111e25, archive paper #f3eddf, steel #64767e, ocean #305563, signal red #a93427.
identity.typographyIntent: A broad headline, a high-contrast serif documentary voice, and legible sans serif controls.
identity.shapeLanguage: Broad photographic fields and straight chart edges. A slim index rail for reference tools.
motionGrammar: Changes in time, scale and place
identity.densityRhythm: Quiet harbor opening, paper briefing, a photographic break at 7:55, then documentary evidence and open memorial space.
identity.archivalBehavior: Attribution sits alongside authentic images, official documents and marked reconstructions. Text carries essential evidence.
identity.endingLanguage: Return from the memorial to an evidence-based question about contingency.

assetToInterfaceTranslation.paletteSource: Blue-black water and silver highlights in Navy photographs, with warm FDR document paper.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.edgeTreatment: Preserve image tonality. Use a gradient only for text legibility on the opening and attack image.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.controlLanguage: Chart scale and evidence collections. Signal red identifies the attack threshold.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.spacingLanguage: Long margins around testimony and narrow reading columns amid large images.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.transitionLanguage: Scale out from the Pacific to the island and moorings before cutting to Washington.
